items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: How old would he be there, Lois? Do you know? ... I wouldn't go into any trouble, Lois.

ctx.x: It's not as usual. It's not as usual. It's not as usual.

It's not as usual. It's not as usual. It's not as usual. You would have seen him if he went up there sooner. Yeah, I wish I had. And if he was born a little sooner, then you'd see him. How old would he be there, Lois? Do you know? Well, he'd be, let me see, this picture here. He died at 43. He died at 43. This picture was taken. Pretty careful, 24, 23, 255, in the front of Boston, Massachusetts. Now, let me see. Let me see. Let me see now what's in there. No. No, he ain't got it in there. He looks quite young…

Wait, maybe we can push that up there. Yeah. Now, is it got any writing back here? Something, but I don't see what it is for sure. No, they ain't got nothing. No, I guess it doesn't tell. It was made on an old postcard-sized paper. So I just put this here. You see? It looks to me like it might have been when he was still with that Creole band, with the Barkay and all, do you think? Well, when he was up there with Barkay and then for a garden. It looks to me like that period with the uniform and all like that. It…
